summary_en: COMSYS Holdings will acquire all shares of AI-NET Corporation through a simplified stock exchange, issuing 404,200 treasury shares at a ratio of 0.43 COMSYS shares per AI-NET share. The transaction is scheduled to take effect on January 4, 2027, and does not require COMSYS shareholders' approval under the simplified procedure. The acquisition aims to leverage synergies between TOSYS (COMSYS' subsidiary) and AI-NET to strengthen their market position in the Nagano/Shinshu region.
title_en: Notice of Complete Subsidiary Status for AI-NET Corporation through Simplified Stock Exchange
translation_en_brief:
COMSYS Holdings Corporation has decided to make AI-NET Corporation a wholly owned subsidiary through a simplified stock exchange. Under this transaction, COMSYS will issue 404,200 shares of its common stock to AI-NET shareholders at an exchange ratio of 0.43 COMSYS shares for each AI-NET share. The shares to be issued will come entirely from COMSYS' treasury stock. The transaction is scheduled to take effect on January 4, 2027.

The simplified stock exchange procedure allows COMSYS to proceed without obtaining approval from its own shareholders under Company Law Article 796(2), while AI-NET will require approval from its shareholders at an ordinary general meeting scheduled for November 20, 2026. The exchange ratio was determined with the assistance of an independent third-party valuation firm, Maxus Corporate Advisory, to ensure fairness and reasonableness. Both companies' boards of directors approved the stock exchange agreement on November 6, 2026.

The primary purpose of this acquisition is to maximize synergies between TOSYS (COMSYS' existing wholly owned subsidiary) and AI-NET. TOSYS primarily handles telecommunications infrastructure network construction for NTT Group and other telecommunications carriers in the Nagano and Yamanashi regions, while AI-NET, based in Nagano Prefecture, engages in electrical and telecommunications equipment installation work. The combined entity will strengthen its operational foundation in the Shinshu region and expand service offerings across access network construction, mobile quality improvement projects, and social infrastructure systems, thereby enhancing enterprise value for the COMSYS Group.
